title: Bhoola hai na
body:
bhoola hai na bhoolega ta hashr zamana
darbar e yazeedi mein tera khutba sunana
<<DIVIDER>>
tere parde pe qurban tere bhai ke sadqe
aata hai jise deen pe ghar baar lutana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ne ye dars zamane ko diya hai
aage kisi zaalim ke kabhi sar na jhukana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
hurmul ye tera jurm kabhi chup nahi sakta
pani ke ewaz teer se asghar ko sulaana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
shabbir ki azmat hai ye shbbir ke jurrat
maqtal mein wo akbar ke laashe ko uthana
bhoola hai na...
<<DIVIDER>>
mushtaq kiye jaa tu isi dar ki ghulami
bakshish ka nahi aisa koi aur thikana
bhoola hai na...
author: Mushtaq Hussain
